title: Transfer Catalog Entry
description: Advisory, provenance-bearing learning observation for transfer between SkillWeave instances (SW1311-TRANSFER-001). An entry is a scoped observation with an explicit category, claim, resolvable provenance artifacts, observed task/profile/harness scope, confidence, contraindications, limitations and a review date or validity window. It is never a routing command and never a mutable policy decision. Model tiers (flash/pro) and harness capability surfaces are the provider-neutral vocabulary; concrete vendor, model or harness names are never required.

review_date.description: Date the observation was reviewed (YYYY-MM-DD). Either review_date or validity_window is required.

status.description: active observations may be retrieved as advisory; superseded/contradicted observations stay queryable with their disposition and never overwrite history.

supersedes.description: entry_id this entry supersedes, when the newer observation narrows or replaces an older one.

disposition.description: Why a superseded/contradicted observation is no longer advisory, or how it was narrowed.

metadata.description: Free-form entry metadata. Export redacts restricted fields (private prompts, secrets, hidden reasoning) inside metadata; it is never exported verbatim.

artifact_path.description: Repository-relative path of the artifact. Resolvable when the file exists under the repository root or the sha256 content address can be verified.

sha256.description: Content address of the immutable artifact; makes provenance resolvable even when the file is not checked out.

source_name.description: Explicit source name retained as-is (e.g. the 2026-08-28 report filename).

sensitivity.description: Artifact sensitivity; export applies the artifact policy and redacts content above the allowed level.

task.description: Opaque task label the observation applies to.

profile.description: Opaque profile label (e.g. software-product-delivery). Optional; concrete names are never required.

model_tiers.description: Provider-neutral capability tiers observed, never vendor product names.

capabilities.description: Provider-neutral harness capability surfaces, aligned with harness-capability.schema.json.

names.description: Optional concrete harness names as opaque adapter data. Never required.
